test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the sentence that uses a homonym of the underlined word:

He had to__ tear__ the envelope to open it.

options.text: The comedian caused the audience to tear up with laughter.
He found a small tear in the corner.
Please don't tear the paper again.
She used tape to fix the tear on the bag.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tear"** (as used in the question) means to rip or pull apart something forcefully. (फाड़ना)

 
 
• **Example:** He had to tear the envelope to open it.
 
 
 
• **"Tear" ** can also mean to shed a tear (a drop of liquid from the eyes due to emotion), which is a homonym of the original word. (आंसू)
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian caused the audience to tear up with laughter.
 
 
 
• Since homonyms are words that are pronounced the same but have different meanings, the sentence in Option 1 uses the homonym of the word "tear" (आंसू) instead of "tear" (फाड़ना).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** He found a small tear in the corner. (फाड़ा हुआ हिस्सा)

 
 
• **Example:** The bag had a small tear, so I used tape to fix it.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Please don’t tear the paper again. (फाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked the student not to tear pages from the notebook.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** She used tape to fix the tear on the bag. (फाड़ा हुआ हिस्सा)
 
 
• **Example:** The tear in the fabric was repaired with a patch.
